'''Trailblazers Update 3''' is a revision within the Trailblazers season, released 30 April 2025. Its most significant change was a rework of [[Colonisation]]'s system economy — including how economies develop, population growth, and automatic linking between completed constructions within a system.<ref name="inara-tb3">[https://inara.cz/morps/article/45827/ Elite Dangerous | Trailblazers | Update 3], Inara.</ref>

This page is a demonstration/proof-of-concept for EDFM's Game Update page pattern — it is not yet a complete account of everything the update changed.
